_note: Student-facing change log (idea 5, 2026-11-01). One entry per new official list parsed, new page or date change: date YYYY-MM-DD, title (<= 110 chars), text (one sentence), url (site path or https). Rendered by [am_updates] on /updates/ and as RSS at /updates/feed/. The owner posts each entry on the WhatsApp Channel (site.json social.whatsapp_channel). Add the newest entry anywhere; the page sorts by date.

updates.title: New: IST Islamabad aggregate calculator (engineering and computing)
updates.text: IST's official merit formula: engineering 20% Matric + 40% FSc Part-I + 40% entry test (NAT, USAT, NET, ECAT, ETEA), computing and science 40% Matric + 60% FSc Part-I with no test.

updates.title: New: closing merit positions (merit numbers) for every UHS medical and dental college
updates.text: The MDCAT merit list now shows the UHS merit number of the last open-merit student admitted to each college in 2025: KEMU 440, Narowal Medical College 3,516 in the final public MBBS list.

updates.title: New: see in which UHS list your aggregate would have got a seat, and all aggregates at once
updates.text: Enter your MDCAT aggregate to see, college by college, the first of last year's 13 UHS lists that reached it; or type your marks once and get your aggregate for every university.

updates.title: UET Lahore Fall 2026 closing merit added (1st and 4th merit lists)
updates.text: Official Fall 2026 closing merit for every UET Lahore program, campus and category from the live admission portal: main-campus Computer Science 85.37%, Cybersecurity 85.60%, Electrical 83.33% (A1, 4th list).

updates.title: New: compare two colleges or programs side by side
updates.text: Closing merit by year for any two programs or medical colleges, with the difference and the official list behind every figure (for example KEMU 94.87% vs AIMC 94.45% in 2025).

updates.title: Hafiz-e-Quran marks fixed in the PU, UET Taxila and KU calculators
updates.text: The 20 additional marks are now added in full, as the official formulas do. Before, a top score with Hafiz marks was capped at the total (PU 1000 + 1090 + Hafiz now shows 98.91%).

updates.title: Merit tables: search box, college name on phones, charts
updates.text: Search any program or college in a merit table, see the college under each program on a phone, and new charts on the MDCAT, UET and PU merit lists.

updates.title: Shareable results: send your aggregate and chances on WhatsApp
updates.text: Every calculator and predictor result now has its own link; the WhatsApp text carries the aggregate and how many programs are Strong or Borderline.

updates.title: UHS MBBS/BDS 2026-27 schedule page with countdown
updates.text: Provisional merit 13 Nov, final merit 16 Nov, first selection list 17 Nov 2026; BDS applications 15 to 30 Dec, from the UHS advertisement.

updates.title: 17 Punjab medical college pages: 2025 closing merit list by list, seats and fee
updates.text: KEMU to Narowal: open-merit closing aggregate in every 2025 UHS selection list (1st to 13th), 2026-27 seats per category and the annual fee.

updates.title: UET Lahore campus merit lists: KSK, Faisalabad, Narowal, RCET Gujranwala
updates.text: Fall 2025 fourth-list closing aggregates per campus with the Fall 2024 portal table for the trend.

updates.title: MDCAT passing marks and eligibility check
updates.text: 55% in MDCAT for MBBS, 50% for BDS, 60% in FSc, from the Punjab admission policy 2026-27, with a live check of your marks.

updates.title: NUMS 2024-25 closing merits added
updates.text: Two years of NUMS closing aggregates (2024-25 and 2025-26) from the official lists and Wayback copies.

updates.title: ITU 2025, PU 2023-2024, UET Lahore Fall 2024 and COMSATS Fall 2023 closing merits added
updates.text: Older official years added for the trend charts; the newest year stays the default view.

updates.title: UET Lahore Fall 2025 merit list (593 rows) and ECAT aggregate calculator
updates.text: Fourth merit list closing aggregates for every campus and category, with the 33/50/17 prospectus formula.

updates.title: COMSATS Fall 2025 and NUMS 2025-26 merit lists
updates.text: Official closing merits for COMSATS Islamabad campuses and the NUMS MBBS/BDS colleges.

updates.title: Merit predictor launched
updates.text: Enter your aggregate and see every program where the newest official closing merit is below, near or above it.

updates.title: PU and KU merit lists
updates.text: Punjab University 'Merit of Last Year 2025' (257 programs) and University of Karachi closing percentages for Admissions 2027.

updates.title: MDCAT merit list 2024-2025 and MDCAT aggregate calculator
updates.text: UHS public and private MBBS/BDS closing merits for 2024 and 2025 (1st and final lists) with the 10/40/50 formula.
